**Introduction:**
This lanky elf is fair of hair and skin, with green eyes just verging on blue. He is unkempt, with a dirty undershirt and torn trousers worn under a huge, fleece-lined green overcoat. He fidgets - tugging at the lobes of his pointed ears and fiddling with the overlarge sleeves of his coat - and though he seems nervous, he smiles easily.

**Description**
"My name is Davidson Wintergreen and I would love to interest you in an investment opportunity."
The hard to place accent turns love into *luv* and opportunity into something like *ohpourtuuneetee*. The cadence of his speech is broken, filled with pauses for breath ("*My. Name. Is Davidson Wintergreen. And. I. Would love to interest. You. In an investment opportunity.*")
"I am an inventor, you see. All kinds of things can I make. Toys for the children, Tools for work and home," a gleam of something mischievous touches his eye, and the tone of his voice becomes more relaxed, confident.
" - weapons of war?"
"But the money. Yes. I am penniless, you see. As are so many others. Hard times fall on all of Empire City. We must work together! When one is hungry, all are hungry."
"This is why you must trust me! I will buy the materials, build the wonders, make one coin into five, twenty, one hundred! Soon I will build a factory, and employ dozens, scores of hungry workers!"
His fervent, slightly crazed look cracks and falls, and for an instant a glimpse of confused despair takes over. Then his nervous smile returns, wider and more ingratiating.
"Ah, so you are broke too, huh? Come, I have some copper. Let us drink it."
